notes: Same access route as bs10/na10: direct HTTPS to www.interiordefine.com/graphql (Magento GraphQL, curl_cffi impersonate=chrome), no proxy, no block encountered. Discovery via the full 214-category GraphQL tree (categories(filters:{}, pageSize:200), 2 pages, total_count=214 all retrieved) - this is the data source the site's own mega menu/nav renders from. Found 'Warehouse Sale' (url_path 'warehouse', level 2, id 660) with 5 real site-defined children whose url_path is nested under warehouse/: Warehouse Sectionals, Warehouse Sofas, Warehouse Dining, Warehouse Accent Seating, Warehouse Beds. Applied the Sale-vs-Clearance test from the brief: fetched the category's own on-page description text (HTML-stripped) which reads 'One-of-a-kind finds - up to 60% off and ready to ship. All items are final sale.' - this is an explicit permanence signal ('final sale', 'one-of-a-kind' floor-sample/overstock language), not a generic temporary promo, so it clears the bar for Clearance under the site's own taxonomy. SKUs in this category are also prefixed distinctly (e.g. 'CAN.SC0211547HV...') vs the made-to-order SKUs used everywhere else on the site, consistent with a genuine one-off outlet/clearance stock pool. Kept 'Warehouse Sale' as the grouping parent (is_group=true) plus its 5 children as leaves; note the parent's total (242, confirmed via both category.product_count and a direct products(filter:{category_id}) query) does not exactly equal the sum of the 5 children (167) - this is expected Magento anchor-category behavior (parent can also hold directly-assigned products beyond what rolls up from listed children) and is not treated as an error per the brief's overlap-is-expected guidance. Considered and EXCLUDED: 'In Stock' (in-stock, 75 products, level 2 sibling of Warehouse Sale, not nested under it) - this reads as a ready-to-ship/availability filter, not a markdown or outlet listing; no description text and no clearance-family wording, so it does not meet the brief's target-term bar and was left out rather than force-flagged as ambiguous. Also probed urlResolver guesses: 'sale' resolves to category id 550 but that category no longer exists server-side (category(id:550) returns 'Category doesn't exist' and its products query returns total_count=0) - a dead/legacy URL with zero products, correctly dropped per the zero-product rule. Guesses clearance, outlet, final-sale, last-chance, end-of-line all resolved to nothing. No robots.txt Claude-specific disallow found.

rows.evidence: GraphQL products(filter:{category_id:{eq:"660"}}).total_count = 242 (matches category(id:660).product_count = 242); category description text: 'One-of-a-kind finds - up to 60% off and ready to ship. All items are final sale.'
